description: Fetch historical CPU, RAM, disk, and player-count time series for an instance (by id or exact name) over the last day, 3 days, week, or month. Returns both summary stats (min/max/avg) and the raw points. Use for trend and usage analysis questions like "was my server busy yesterday?"

include_points.description: If true, include the raw {x: timestamp, y: value} points alongside summary stats. Defaults to false. Only request raw points when you need per-timestamp detail.

instance.description: Instance id (preferred) or exact instance name.

time.description: Time window to fetch. Defaults to "day".

name: get_instance_usage_history
title: Get Instance Usage History
